newsitem.title: UK: UK logistics firm Gefco names two new U.S. agents.
newsitem.headline: UK logistics firm Gefco names two new U.S. agents.

text.p: Gefco UK, a London-based freight forwarder and logistics company, said it has appointed two new U.S agents to handle its freight services between Britain and the United States.
Tricor International has been appointed to handle airfreight while Ideal Consolidators Ltd has been given ocean freight.responsibilities.
In a statement, Gefco said Tricor is a U.S. airfreight forwarder with 110 offices throughout the United States, including locations at all main airports.
It added that the company has been involved in trial operations with Gefco since 1996 and also includes courier services in its product range.
Ideal Consolidators operates through a network of six hubs serving main U.S. gateway ports, including Los Angeles, New York, Chicago, Seattle and New Jersey.
